extension.summary: Widgets and lists from your self-hosted Floppy tracker
extension.description: Browse your Floppy (self-hosted media tracker) library from Kodi: Continue Watching, Next Up, Top Picks, Trending, watchlists, history, calendar and your own lists. Every category can be used as a skin widget. Items play through any player add-on you configure, and resume positions are saved back to Floppy.
extension.disclaimer: Requires a running Floppy instance and its API token (Settings, Integrations, API Token).
extension.news: 1.3.6: Images settings: poster, background, clear logo and episode thumbnail sizes (smaller posters by default) so widget rows load sooner on slow TVs. Artwork fetched in the background now reloads widgets once per batch instead of every 2 seconds. 1.3.5: Path picker lists installed player files with their add-ons' icons, including ones add-ons ship themselves (no TMDb Helper needed). 1.3.4: Genres menu under Discover: popular TMDb movies and shows by category. Genre listings page with page=N. 1.3.3: Genre listing for skins (action=genre): popular movies and shows by TMDb genre, original language or keyword, mixed, for search categories such as skin.ultra's. Uses the TMDb API key in Artwork settings. 1.3.2: Background trailers played by skin.ultra are no longer tracked and don't take a pending play's details. 1.3.0: No longer needs TMDb Helper: play through any add-on with a plugin path (browse add-ons or pick a TMDb Helper-style player file) or a custom URL, with TMDb Helper placeholders and encodings. Playback started outside Floppy, such as from a skin, is tracked and resumed too. Search results carry full tracked state, anime included. Episode lists fill missing plots, runtimes and stills from TMDb. Skins get watchlist status and the show's IMDb id on episodes. Widgets refresh only when Floppy data changes, unless Refresh widgets automatically is on. Playback settings changed: choose your player again under Playback.

extension.summary: Watched status, resume points and watchlists kept in Kodi, with TMDb lists
extension.description: Keeps track of what you watch without a server: watched status, resume points, Next Up and your watchlist live in a small database inside Kodi. Lists include Continue Watching, Next Up, In Progress, Watchlist and Recently Watched, plus Trending, Popular and Top Rated from TMDb, search and genres. Every list can be used as a skin widget. Items play through any player add-on you configure, and videos started elsewhere, such as from a skin, are tracked too.
extension.disclaimer: Artwork, details, search and the TMDb lists need a free TMDb API key (Settings, TMDb).
extension.news: 0.1.3: Logos TMDb stores as SVG (e.g. Stranger Things) now load: they're fetched as PNG, which Kodi can draw. 0.1.2: Poster, fanart, logo and episode image sizes in the new Images settings (posters now w342, faster on TVs); widgets reload once after artwork is fetched instead of repeatedly. 0.1.1: Path picker lists installed player files with their add-ons' icons, including ones add-ons ship themselves (no TMDb Helper needed). 0.1.0: First version: local watched status, resume points, Next Up and watchlist; TMDb trending, popular, top rated, search and genres.

extension.description: Torrest is a service with a rest API which allows torrent streaming.
extension.news: - [0.0.24] webOS: a soft-float daemon build for LG TVs (upstream's armv7 one can't run there), and a clear message instead of a crash when the daemon can't run on a device - [0.0.23] download_magnet: download a torrent, or one of its files, without playing it (for Ultra Player's Download) - Update torrest binary to v0.0.8 - Add proper info to the play list item

extension.summary: Plays movies and episodes from Stremio and Nuvio add-ons.
extension.description: A player for Kodi: give it a title's ids and it asks your Stremio-protocol add-ons (Torrentio, AIOStreams, ...) and player add-ons for streams, then plays the best one or the one you pick. Use it from skin.ultra, Floppy, TMDb Helper or any add-on that takes a player path. Manage sources adds, configures, reorders and removes them. Download (in a movie or episode's context menu) saves a title for later; downloads and library copies play first, without asking the sources.

extension.summary: Floppy, its TMDb Helper sync, Ultra Player and a Torrest fork.
extension.description: Installs and updates haywirephoenix's Kodi add-ons: Floppy, TMDbHelper Sync - Floppy, Ultra Player (plays titles from Stremio and Nuvio add-ons), and a Torrest fork with buffering status for skins.

Watched history, resume points, watchlist, dropped shows, next episodes, synced-state actions and scrobbling for TMDbHelper from a self-hosted Floppy tracker. Uses the address and API token from the Floppy add-on (plugin.video.floppy) unless set here.
extension.disclaimer: Requires a running Floppy instance and its API token (Floppy, Settings, Integrations, API Token).

extension.summary: Installs the Floppy sync provider for TMDbHelper.
extension.description: Installs TMDbHelper Sync - Floppy, which syncs watched history, resume points, watchlist, dropped shows and next episodes between TMDbHelper and a self-hosted Floppy tracker, and scrobbles to it. Open this add-on to set the sync up: your Floppy address and API token (or leave them to the Floppy add-on), then choose Floppy in TMDbHelper's settings.
extension.disclaimer: Requires a running Floppy instance and its API token (Floppy, Settings, Integrations, API Token).
